method: Production assets served with gzip. Isolated contexts for cold loads; reload within same context for warm. CDP CPU/network controls. Interactions include Playwright dispatch and two animation frames; not real-device INP. ScriptDuration is cumulative execution, not parsing bytes. Heap is CDP approximate live heap without forced GC. LCP is last observation at snapshot, not a final Core Web Vital. Encoded resource body is measured gzip; transfer includes protocol overhead. No routing (preserves HTTP cache).
